preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
Length of each permutation is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, 1 <= q_i <= n
preconditions.description: Each element in q is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, len(min_perm) == n and len(max_perm) == n
postconditions.description: Both minimal and maximal permutations have the same length as q.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, min_perm[i] <= max_perm[i] for all i
postconditions.description: Minimal permutation is lexicographically smaller than or equal to maximal permutation.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, q[i] == max(min_perm[1:i+1]) for all i
postconditions.description: Minimal permutation generates q when transformed.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, q[i] == max(max_perm[1:i+1]) for all i
postconditions.description: Maximal permutation generates q when transformed.
